# Faegre Drinker Biddle & Reath LLP

> A full-service international law firm with 18+ global offices providing corporate, litigation, M&A, and specialized legal services across multiple industries.

Faegre Drinker Biddle & Reath LLP is a major law firm headquartered in Minneapolis with significant presence in major U.S. cities and international markets. The firm serves clients across financial services, healthcare, food and beverage, technology, and other key sectors with expertise in corporate transactions, regulatory compliance, litigation, and emerging areas like data center services and artificial intelligence.
